item.title: Staff Data Scientist, Growth Analytics - Airwallex
item.description:
**About Airwallex** -------------------
Airwallex is the AI-native financial operating system for a real-time, intelligent economy. More than 675,000 businesses, including McLaren Racing, Qantas, SHEIN, and TikTok, use us, directly or through our platform partners, to run their financial operations or build and monetize financial products of their own.
We started in Melbourne in 2015 to build the infrastructure global commerce runs on. We're the regulated backbone behind global payments: not by accident, but by design. A decade plus, 85+ licenses, and a financial infrastructure spanning North America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific.
We're co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore, with more than 2,700 people across 27 offices. We hire builders with founder-level energy, people who move fast with good judgment, dig in with real curiosity, and make calls from first principles rather than waiting to be told what to do. Read our operating principles to see it in full.
**About the team**
The Growth Analytics team at Airwallex is a dynamic group of data scientists and analytics professionals. We are passionate about leveraging data to drive business growth, optimize strategies, and unlock new opportunities across the company. As key partners to Growth, Marketing, Sales, and Product, our team works collaboratively to enable data-informed decision-making, experimentation, and scalable measurement frameworks supporting Airwallex’s global expansion.
**What you’ll do**
You will be the technical lead for the Growth Analytics team, working cross-functionally to identify growth opportunities, shape data science initiatives, and drive impactful strategies. You’ll mentor junior data scientists, partner with business stakeholders, and translate complex business questions into actionable analytic solutions. This role offers you the chance to help shape the next phase of Airwallex’s growth with data-driven leadership and innovation.
This hybrid role is based in San Francisco or New York City.
**Responsibilities:**
* Act as a technical partner to Growth, Marketing, Sales, and Data Science leaders to develop and implement Airwallex’s growth strategy. * Lead and mentor the team in applying data science techniques—including root-cause analysis, statistical modeling, and experimentation—to unlock acquisition, activation, retention, and reactivation. * Design and implement robust, scalable measurement frameworks for data-driven decision-making across multiple teams. * Communicate complex data insights and recommendations clearly and persuasively to both technical and non-technical audiences, ensuring findings drive business impact. * Translate open-ended or complex business problems into structured, high-impact data science initiatives. * Mentor and coach junior data scientists, serving as the single-threaded technical owner on critical cross-functional projects.
**Who you are**
We’re looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.
**Minimum qualifications:**
* At least 7 years of industry experience and a degree in a quantitative field (e.g. Statistics, Engineering, Sciences, Computer Science, Economics). Advanced degree (PhD or MS) preferred. * Proven experience mentoring or leading data science or analytics teams. * Strong communication and interpersonal skills; demonstrated ability to influence strategy in high-growth, cross-functional environments. * Track record of applying data science to drive measurable growth outcomes. * Technical proficiency with SQL and Python/R; experience in data modeling is a plus. * Experience in technology, financial services, or high-growth environments is advantageous.
**Preferred qualifications:**
* Experience mentoring teams in a fast-paced, startup, or fintech environment.
**Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters** -------------------------------------------------------------
*To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @**airwallex.com* *email address. Please apply only through* *careers.airwallex.com* *or our official LinkedIn page.*
*Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*
**Equal opportunity** ---------------------
Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

item.title: Data Scientist, Finance - Meta
item.description:
Meta is seeking a highly quantitative, analytical, and motivated data scientist for the Finance Data Science team. The Finance DS team has a unique bird's-eye view of Meta's large-scale advertising business and is positioned at the center of some of the most important strategic decisions for the company. The team is responsible for deeply understanding business drivers, accurately forecasting revenue, identifying opportunities/risks, and maximizing ROI on the largest investments across the family of apps (Facebook, Instagram, Messenger, WhatsApp). This position will focus heavily on analyzing and modeling revenue drivers, understanding the ads ecosystem, building forecast models, and developing actionable insights to influence strong financial decision making. The role is highly cross-functional and partner facing, involving coordination across a variety of data science, product, and finance teams. Candidates should have a track record of delivering actionable and data-driven insights; you're able to effectively combine deep technical expertise and business acumen, and drive to results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment. As an individual contributor, you will also be expected to raise the quality of the data science craft at Meta, and to provide technical leadership and mentorship to other data scientists.
### **Data Scientist, Finance Responsibilities:**
* Own and lead data science projects end-to-end in partnership with other data science, finance, or cross-functional teams to inform and influence product investment decisions * Build frameworks and statistical models to analyze business implications, influence measurement standards, and extrapolate experiment results and historical trends into accurate and explainable forecasts * Work with large and complex data sets to solve a wide array of challenging problems using different analytical and statistical approaches * Navigate complex cross-functional situations and evaluate statistical analyses by other data science teams to reach alignment on objective business outcomes * Influence financial and product direction through clear and compelling presentations, including to leadership * Raise the bar of data science at Meta, including but not limited to driving data best practices (e.g., analysis, goaling, forecasting), improving analytical processes, scaling knowledge and tools, and mentoring other data scientists
### **Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in a directly related field, or equivalent practical experience * 8+ years of experience in data science, quantitative analysis, or predictive modeling to inform business/financial strategy * Experience extracting and manipulating large datasets using data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python), and/or statistical software (e.g., R) * Work experience applying statistical methods (e.g., regressions, time series, causal inference, econometrics) * Proven track record in synthesizing strategic insights to influence decision-making through data-centric presentations, and communicating effectively across business and technical domains (including to executive audiences) * Experience collaborating across teams, communicating business insights to technical and non-technical stakeholders, and leading cross-functional initiatives - with a track record of shaping analytical best practices and influencing data-driven decisions * Experience independently identifying high-impact opportunities and driving projects to completion with measurable outcomes
### **Preferred Qualifications:**
* Advanced degree in a quantitative field * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Prior experience in a fast-paced, large-scale company or previous experience with the digital ads business * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews)
### **About Meta:**
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.
$177,000/year to $247,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits
Individual compensation is determined by skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Compensation details listed in this posting reflect the base hourly rate, monthly rate, or annual salary only, and do not include bonus, equity or sales incentives, if applicable. In addition to base compensation, Meta offers benefits. Learn more about benefits at Meta.

item.title: (USA) Principal, Data Scientist - Walmart
item.description:
**Position Summary...** -----------------------
Role summary: We are seeking a Principal Data Scientist to lead the development of computer vision capabilities for Walmart store use cases. In this hands-on role, you will translate complex retail challenges into scalable AI solutions that interpret visual data, generate actionable insights, and support better operational decisions. You will lead the data science lifecycle, from problem framing and data strategy to model development, evaluation, and production deployment. You will partner with product, engineering, data science, and business teams to deliver measurable impact. As a technical leader, you will set direction, mentor team members, and advance computer vision capabilities across store environments. About the team: Walmart Data Ventures powers the data and AI platform supporting the world’s largest retailer’s suppliers. The Walmart Scintilla team transforms extensive data into actionable insights, recommendations, and innovations that enhance customer, merchant, and supplier outcomes. This team leads advancements in generative AI, agentic intelligence, machine learning, measurement, and causal inference to redefine retail experiences, optimize operations, and develop new business models. Joining this team offers the opportunity to lead cutting-edge AI initiatives that set industry standards and drive significant impact across the retail ecosystem.
**What you'll do...** ---------------------
**What you'll do:**
* Lead the development of computer vision capabilities for Walmart store use cases, translating business challenges into well-defined AI problems. * Design and develop models for visual recognition, object detection, segmentation, and other relevant tasks. * Define data collection, labeling, and evaluation strategies to ensure models perform across store environments. * Explore vision foundation models and multimodal techniques where they can improve performance or enable new capabilities. * Partner with engineering teams to deploy, monitor, and improve production solutions. * Measure technical performance and business impact. * Set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and collaborate with product and business stakeholders.
**What you'll bring:**
* Deep, hands-on expertise in computer vision, including object detection, image classification, segmentation, or visual recognition. * Strong understanding of deep learning architectures and experience training, fine-tuning, and evaluating vision models using PyTorch or TensorFlow. * Experience building representative image datasets and defining data labeling and quality strategies. * Ability to evaluate model performance across real-world conditions and connect technical results to business outcomes. * Strong Python programming skills and experience bringing machine learning solutions into production. * Ability to frame ambiguous problems, set technical direction, mentor data scientists, and influence cross-functional teams. * Experience with vision-language or multimodal models is a plus.

item.title: Applied Scientist II, Brand Optimization - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
Amazon Advertising is one of Amazon's fastest growing businesses, responsible for defining and delivering a collection of advertising products that drive discovery and sales. Brand advertising is at the center of that growth, and brand marketers are pushing the industry toward a fundamental shift: they no longer want to optimize toward proxy metrics like reach and frequency alone. They want their investment across Streaming TV, online video, and display to drive measurable business outcomes, from consideration through to purchase and long-term loyalty. The core scientific challenge is connecting a brand ad exposure today to an outcome that may happen days or weeks later, and then optimizing for it in real time.
The Brand Outcomes Optimization team exists to solve that challenge. We build machine-learned models that predict how likely a customer is to move along the full funnel, from awareness through conversion, and we integrate those predictions into real-time bidding so that every brand bid is placed on the opportunity most likely to produce the outcome the advertiser cares about. These systems operate at large scale, and even small improvements to how we predict and optimize for outcomes have meaningful and immediate impact on advertiser results.
As an Applied Scientist II, you will help drive this outcome-optimization. You will take on increasingly ambiguous problems, from predicting what a brand outcome will be, to building the bidding and control algorithms that optimize for it, to proving the lift through experimentation. You will work alongside senior scientists and engineers, applying advances in machine learning, online optimization, optimal control, forecasting, and causal inference. You will also join the Amazon science community, with opportunities to publish papers, attend workshops and conferences, and gain early access to Amazon ML technologies.
Key job responsibilities In this role, you will work with a highly motivated team of ML scientists and engineers focused on making brand advertising measurable and optimizable against real outcomes. As an Applied Scientist II, you will:

* Experience in state-of-the-art deep learning models architecture design and deep learning training and optimization and model pruning

item.title: Data Scientist, Finance - Rox Data Corp
item.description:
**About Us** ------------
At Rox, we believe in empowering people to do their best work.
Our platform supercharges sellers with autonomous revenue agents to do the manual work so they can focus on what they do best: selling. Just as coding agents 10x’d engineering, revenue agents 10x customer work.
We are reimagining the revenue stack by building the world’s first revenue operating system, from the application layer to the system of context. With Rox, humans are evolving to orchestrators while agents manage the end-to-end customer lifecycle.
Rox powers Global 2000 leaders in banking, hardware, construction, and sovereign AI, while serving dominant AI winners like Ramp and Cognition.
Underlying all of this success is a unwavering, shared belief in the mission, with an unreasonable commitment of doing whatever it takes to make it a reality.
**The Team** ------------
Nothing is possible without the world-class team, assembled to redefine how businesses operate.
Members on our team have:
* Founded and exited successful companies * Held the highest positions at Google, AWS, Confluent, and New Relic * Won IMO and IOI gold medals * Published field-defining papers
We’re backed by the best, having raised $50M from Sequoia (Alfred Lin), General Catalyst (Hemant Taneja), Google Ventures, Elad Gil, and Chris Ré.
**Core Principles** -------------------
### **Taste:** ***Craft beautiful experiences.***
No matter how small, we strive to make sure every detail is right. We care deeply about every interaction, both in terms of whether it helps the seller get the job done, but also how the product makes them feel. We get a visceral feeling when something is off and stop at nothing to make sure we make it right. We never settle, continuously exploring ways to delight sellers.
### **Obsession:** ***Commit unreasonably.***
In all aspects of our craft, we commit. We not only are immediately reactive to customers’ requests but are proactive about driving value even before they ask. We are also obsessive about always learning and honing our craft, improving ourselves and product every single day.
### **Action:** ***Get it done.***
Talking is easy but the difference comes from the execution. We lean heavily towards making thoughtful yet fast decisions and delivering immediately. We play in a field where trust is paramount. We earn the trust and right to empower the best sellers by forging a history of over-delivering on the promise at record speed.
**Role** --------
As a Finance Data Scientist at Rox, you will own the numbers that explain what it costs to run an agentic product and what we earn from it. Every agent action has a real cost in models, enrichment and infrastructure. Your work tells the company which products and customers are profitable, why, and what to change.
You will sit between Finance, Engineering and GTM. You will build the cost and margin models, reconcile contracts and revenue across systems, catch cost anomalies before they reach the P&L, and give leadership a view of unit economics they can run the business on.
This is a high-ownership role on a small data team. You will be as comfortable in a dbt model as in a month-end close conversation, and you will be expected to push back with evidence when a number does not tie.
You'll be one of Rox's first dedicated data hires. It's an opportunity to help build an agile data function from the ground up at an early-stage, fast-growing company.
**Responsibilities** ====================
* Own COGS reporting end to end: LLM, enrichment vendor and infrastructure costs. * Build and maintain gross margin reporting by product and customer, tied out to the general ledger and delivered to Finance and leadership on a set cadence. * Track cost per action and its drivers, and partner with Engineering to triage the most expensive workloads and push margins higher. * Run cost anomaly detection so that a model change, a vendor price change or a runaway workflow is flagged in days, not at month end. * Build the single source of truth for contracts, ARR and revenue across the CRM, the ERP and the warehouse, including the closed-won to ARR process. * Model consumption against contract commitments to support pricing, packaging, overage and renewal decisions. * Produce the repeatable business metrics pack for the board and investors: ARR, net retention, gross margin and unit economics, with definitions that hold up to diligence. * Build and maintain the dbt models and Snowflake pipelines behind all of the above, including vendor billing and ERP data ingestion.
**Qualifications** ==================
### **Required**
* Degree in a quantitative field (e.g., Mathematics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, Finance) * 2 to 5+ years in analytics, FP&A, strategic finance or data science at a fast-growing company, with direct ownership of cost, margin or revenue models * Strong SQL and Python, comfortable with large, messy billing, metering and usage data * Working knowledge of SaaS finance: ARR, revenue recognition basics, COGS versus opex, gross margin and net retention * Experience with dbt and a modern warehouse, and with dashboards in Sigma, Looker, Tableau, Mode or equivalent * A reconciliation habit: you tie numbers to source systems and can explain every variance * Able to explain a cost or margin finding to both an engineer and a CFO * High energy, "no job is too small" mentality, and extreme ownership * Located in or willing to relocate to San Francisco
### **Preferred**
* Experience at a consumption or usage-based business (e.g., Datadog, New Relic, Snowflake), with fluency in usage metering and unit economics * Experience with the cost structure of AI products: token pricing, model routing and third-party data vendors * Experience with ERP and billing systems, and with getting their data into a warehouse * Experience supporting a fundraise, audit or board reporting cycle * Experience with pricing and packaging analysis * Comfort with AI-native development tools such as Cursor and Claude Code
**Benefits** ------------
* Competitive pay with considerable equity upside * Health Insurance
**Apply** ---------
To apply, please fill out the application form. We're looking forward to connecting with you!

item.description:
**Company Description**
At SAP, you will be part of a global environment that values shared learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement. You will work across international teams, exchange knowledge openly, and develop alongside colleagues committed to advancing machine learning engineering practices. SAP's culture encourages curiosity, inclusion, and growth, giving you opportunities to contribute meaningfully no matter your level.
**Job Description**
**What you'll bring** You have hands-on experience building and operating ML systems in production, with solid skills in Python, data pipelines, and ranking or retrieval systems.
* Python proficiency and hands-on experience with ML frameworks such as PyTorch or scikit-learn. * Experience building or maintaining data pipelines at scale. Spark, Databricks, Delta Lake, or equivalent. * Solid knowledge of ranking, retrieval, or recommendation systems; experience with multi-signal fusion or semantic search is a plus. * SQL fluency and comfort working with large-scale columnar data stores. * End-to-end ML ownership across training, evaluation, serving, and monitoring; experience with A/B experimentation is a plus. * Degree not required for this role.
We also look for people who build trust naturally, communicate with clarity, keep the customer at the centre of what they do, and bring emotional intelligence and genuine problem-solving ability to the challenges they face.
In addition to the skills and experience specific to this role, all positions at SAP require candidates to be comfortable using AI tools, including agentic AI. Candidates should be able to create effective inputs. They must automate routine tasks and evaluate the quality of AI-generated outputs. Additionally, they should promote the adoption of AI practices within their teams.
**What you'll build** You will build and maintain ML systems that power personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees, covering offline pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops.
* Build and maintain offline ML pipelines for signal extraction, feature engineering, and candidate generation. * Contribute to request-time ranking logic that fuses signals from multiple ML routes into a personalized result. * Extract and transform employee signals; skills, proficiency, and learning history, into reusable, scenario-agnostic feature snapshots. * Design and maintain quality gates that validate ML pipeline outputs before they reach the serving layer. * Build the experimentation infrastructure. This includes A/B schemas, offline evaluation, and ablation testing. These tools will help measure improvements accurately and thoroughly. * Collaborate with Data Scientists, Architects, and Product to refine algorithms and ship end-to-end ML systems.
**Where you belong** You will join a small, high-ownership pod building personalized learning experiences for enterprise employees at scale. The team runs offline ML pipelines, online ranking, and feedback loops in production, processing signals from millions of employees. You will work directly alongside Data Scientists, Architects, and Product from day one, shipping end-to-end ML systems.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

item.description:
**The Company**
PayPal has been revolutionizing commerce globally for more than 25 years. Creating innovative experiences that make moving money, selling, and shopping simple, personalized, and secure, PayPal empowers consumers and businesses in approximately 200 markets to join and thrive in the global economy.
We operate a global, two-sided network at scale that connects hundreds of millions of merchants and consumers. We help merchants and consumers connect, transact, and complete payments, whether they are online or in person. PayPal is more than a connection to third-party payment networks. We provide proprietary payment solutions accepted by merchants that enable the completion of payments on our platform on behalf of our customers.
We offer our customers the flexibility to use their accounts to purchase and receive payments for goods and services, as well as the ability to transfer and withdraw funds. We enable consumers to exchange funds more safely with merchants using a variety of funding sources, which may include a bank account, a PayPal or Venmo account balance, PayPal and Venmo branded credit products, a credit card, a debit card, certain cryptocurrencies, or other stored value products such as gift cards, and eligible credit card rewards. Our PayPal, Venmo, and Xoom products also make it safer and simpler for friends and family to transfer funds to each other. We offer merchants an end-to-end payments solution that provides authorization and settlement capabilities, as well as instant access to funds and payouts. We also help merchants connect with their customers, process exchanges and returns, and manage risk. We enable consumers to engage in cross-border shopping and merchants to extend their global reach while reducing the complexity and friction involved in enabling cross-border trade.
Our beliefs are the foundation for how we conduct business every day. We live each day guided by our core values of Inclusion, Innovation, Collaboration, and Wellness. You will work closely with data scientists, software engineers, and product teams to enhance services through innovative AI/ML solutions. Your role will involve building scalable ML pipelines, ensuring data quality, and deploying models into production environments to drive business insights and improve customer experiences.

* Lead the development and optimization of advanced machine learning models.
* Oversee the preprocessing and analysis of large datasets.
* Deploy and maintain ML solutions in production environments.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate ML models into products and services.
* Monitor and evaluate the performance of deployed models, making necessary adjustments.

* Expertise in cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP) and tools for data processing and model deployment.

* Experience with production ML at scale, including real-time inference, feature stores, model serving and MLOps on cloud platforms such as AWS SageMaker or EKS
* Highly skilled with agentic coding tools and workflows (for example, Claude Code, Cursor or GitHub Copilot) to build, test and ship ML systems faster
* Strong experimentation skills: designing A/B tests, choosing metrics that tie offline gains to online business outcomes, and running rigorous ablations
* Technical leadership without authority: setting technical direction, reviewing designs and code, and mentoring other engineers
* Ability to influence cross-functional partners (product, engineering, data science), negotiate scope and make trade-offs that protect delivery
* Research contributions such as publications, patents or open-source work, with a record of bringing research into production

PayPal

### **Preferred qualifications:**
* Master's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science, Engineering, Physics, Economics, or a related quantitative field. * Experience in media, content, and entertainment analysis. * Experience in measurement and causal inference. * Ability to take open-ended problems, provide better definition and eventually solutions. * Ability to communicate well to various audiences, technical and non-technical.
**About the job** -----------------
YouTube Data Science is a 140+-analyst team that influences and informs YouTube’s product and engineering leadership teams. We have a long history of working on projects that are at the heart of the business and have a seat at the table when it comes to the decisions that drive YouTube's continued success. We work closely with product and engineering teams to improve decision making with science, all with the goal of bringing YouTube users the best entertainment experience possible.
Within YouTube Data Science, the Over-the-Top (OTT) team focuses on over-the-top content, broadly referring to licensed digital media content including sports, movies, and shows. Our subscription products are key growth drivers for YouTube, with YouTube TV exceeding 10M subscribers, NFL Sunday Ticket bringing out-of-market football games to over 3M users, and Primetime Channels connecting over 1M users to their favorite content. As more fans flock to YouTube to meet their entertainment needs, data science plays a crucial role in identifying growth opportunities and informing data-driven decision making.
As a Data Scientist in the OTT team, you will work cross-functionally across Data Science, Product Management, Engineering, UXR, Production Operations, and Marketing. You will leverage product intuition on how users engage with their favorite movies, shows, and sports on YouTube, and combine that intuition with quantitative analysis to inform our product roadmap and growth strategy.At YouTube, we believe that everyone deserves to have a voice, and that the world is a better place when we listen, share, and build community through our stories. We work together to give everyone the power to share their story, explore what they love, and connect with one another in the process. Working at the intersection of cutting-edge technology and boundless creativity, we move at the speed of culture with a shared goal to show people the world. We explore new ideas, solve real problems, and have fun — and we do it all together.Individual pay is determined by factors including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

item.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, Agentic Automated Reasoning Group - Amazon Web Services
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
The Agentic Automated Reasoning Group is building the next generation of software verification tools combining advances in artificial intelligence, the computational capacity of the cloud, and our deep expertise in the domain. Join us if you want to be a part of this transformational endeavor.
The Strata team (https://github.com/strata-org) is seeking a Sr. Applied Scientist with broad interest and expertise in interactive theorem proving, programming language semantics, deductive verification and generative AI. You will combine your expertise with that of your coworkers to build new tools that solve code analysis problems previously considered beyond reach. Our application areas span all the way from Infrastructure as Code to high-performance cryptography written in assembly code.
Each day, hundreds of thousands of developers make billions of transactions worldwide on AWS. They harness the power of the cloud to enable innovative applications, websites, and businesses. Using automated reasoning technology and mathematical proofs, AWS allows customers to answer questions about security, availability, durability, and functional correctness. We call this provable security, absolute assurance in security of the cloud and in the cloud. https://aws.amazon.com/security/provable-security/
Key job responsibilities
* Delivering practical and scalable AR solutions working backwards customer use cases * Identify tools and methods capable of addressing the verification needs of customers, including any novel analysis capabilities required. * Use tools spanning from fuzzers, property-based testing to model checkers, and interactive theorem provers to establish program properties. * Explore generative AI techniques to help customers formalize their requirements, find revealing tests, generate required boiler plate for testing and model checking, and find and repair program proofs.
About the team You will be working with a team of formal verification specialists spanning recently hired PhDs to industry veterans. You will work collaboratively to deliver results in the form of verified code and tools to accelerate code verification for our customer teams.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.

item.title: Member of Technical Staff - Applied Scientist I [Reinforcement Learning and Simulation Environments] - NTT DATA AIVista
item.description:
**Member of Technical Staff - Applied Scientist I** **Reinforcement Learning and Simulation Environments**
San Francisco Bay Area | Bellevue, Washington | Hybrid |
**About AIVista**
NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We work with NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, and NTT DOCOMO to deploy systems for NTT clients. Our clients combine AIVista's product AI expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems-integration experience.
**The Role**
The Applied Scientist will build the learning environments that let AIVista train and evaluate agents before they act in real regulated workflows. You will convert business processes, rules, governed actions, systems of record, documents, and event logs into synthetic, versioned simulations with explicit state, observations, actions, constraints, human-review points, and terminal outcomes.
This role blends reinforcement learning research with environment engineering. You will design reward and cost functions, generate curricula and counterfactual cases, validate simulator fidelity against real operations, and develop offline, safe, constrained, and multi-agent learning methods. The objective is not a demonstration that optimizes a proxy. It is a training and evaluation system that exposes reward hacking, respects governed action boundaries, and predicts whether a policy improves process outcomes without creating unacceptable risk.
**Responsibilities**
* Build synthetic environments and workflow digital twins for regulated enterprise processes, including stochastic events, exceptions, human decisions, delays, and external-system behavior. * Translate process models, rule sets, action contracts, event logs, and operational policies into Markov decision processes, partially observable models, stochastic games, and discrete-event simulations. * Define state, observation, action, termination, reward, cost, and constraint interfaces that are faithful to the underlying workflow and reusable across training and evaluation. * Design reward functions and verifiers, then test them for specification gaming, shortcut learning, reward tampering, and unintended incentives using adversarial and hidden evaluation cases. * Validate environment fidelity against production traces, process-mining results, subject-matter expert review, and counterfactual scenarios; quantify where the simulation does not represent the real process. * Generate synthetic trajectories, rare-event scenarios, and curriculum stages that improve coverage while preserving provenance and reproducibility. * Develop algorithms across offline, safe, constrained, model-based, hierarchical, and multi-agent reinforcement learning, as well as imitation and preference-based learning where appropriate. * Integrate deterministic rule checks, governed actions, safety constraints, and human-review policies into training and rollout evaluation. * Create benchmarks for sample efficiency, generalization, constraint violations, robustness, calibration, latency, cost, and process-level outcomes. * Build scalable environment runners, trajectory stores, experiment infrastructure, and reproducible evaluation pipelines with engineering partners. * Move successful research into production decision-support and agent-training systems, with monitoring for distribution shift and policy regressions. * Lead publications, patents, open-source contributions, and external research partnerships when they advance AIVista's product and science objectives.
**Qualifications**
**Basic**
* PhD in computer science, machine learning, artificial intelligence, operations research, industrial engineering, applied mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry impact.
NTT DATA AIVista | Reinforcement Learning and Simulation EnvironmentsPage
* At least 5 years of experience in artificial intelligence or machine learning, with significant experience applying science and research in production environments. * A proven record of impactful research demonstrated through publications, patents, open-source systems, benchmarks, or shipped AI products. * Deep experience designing reinforcement-learning environments, simulators, reward functions, or sequential-decision systems, not only training policies in existing benchmarks. * Strong foundations in reinforcement learning, stochastic processes, optimization, statistical methods, causal reasoning, and experimental design. * Proficiency in Python and a modern machine-learning framework, with experience building reliable research software that engineering teams can transition to production. * Ability to work with domain experts and translate operational processes, controls, and failure modes into precise learning and evaluation artifacts.
**Preferred**
* Experience with offline, safe or constrained, multi-agent, model-based, hierarchical, or risk-sensitive reinforcement learning. * Experience designing and implementing custom single-agent or multi-agent learning environments, scalable environment runners, and discrete-event process simulations. * Experience with process mining, Business Process Model and Notation, workflow engines, digital twins, operations research, scheduling, or queueing systems. * Experience with language-model agents, reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, verifier-guided training, tool-use agents, or long-horizon agent benchmarks. * Experience detecting reward hacking, specification gaming, data leakage, simulator exploitation, or overfitting to public evaluation cases. * Experience with synthetic data, counterfactual generation, domain randomization, curriculum design, rare-event simulation, or sim-to-real evaluation. * Experience using ontologies, rule systems, action schemas, event logs, or system-of-record interfaces to define environment semantics. * Experience deploying learning or decision systems in regulated or high-stakes domains such as insurance, financial services, healthcare, or public-sector operations.
**Benefits**
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) plan * Significant company Health Savings Account contribution * Paid holidays and flexible paid time off
**Compensation**
The estimated base salary range for this role is $300,000 to $400,000 USD. The salary for the successful applicant will depend on job-related factors such as education, training, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future. Total compensation also includes variable pay in the form of an annual target bonus and other cash incentives, with a combined potential of up to 100% of base salary.

item.title: Member of Technical Staff - Applied Scientist I [Formal Methods for AI Driven Software Development Life Cycle] - NTT DATA AIVista
item.description:
**Member of Technical Staff - Applied Scientist I** **Formal Methods for AI Driven Software Development Life Cycle**
San Francisco Bay Area | Bellevue, Washington | Hybrid
**About AIVista**
NTT DATA AIVista, Inc., a wholly owned subsidiary of NTT DATA, is based in Silicon Valley. We develop AI products for enterprises operating in complex regulatory environments. We work with NTT DATA Inc., NTT DATA Japan, and NTT DOCOMO to deploy systems for NTT clients. Our clients combine AIVista's product AI expertise with NTT DATA's industry knowledge and systems-integration experience.
**The Role**
The Applied Scientist will develop methods that turn natural-language intent into structured, machine-checkable artifacts and use those artifacts to make AI-driven software development more verifiable, traceable, and reliable. You will work from policies, regulations, standard operating procedures, requirements, process descriptions, application programming interfaces, and code to construct formal specifications, rule ontologies, process ontologies, contracts, tests, and proofs with complete source traceability.
The work addresses two distinct assurance problems. Validation asks whether a formal artifact faithfully captures authorized intent. Verification asks whether an implementation satisfies that artifact. You will build measurable validation methods for omissions and mistranslations, integrate independent checkers and proof systems, and carry the resulting evidence through the AI-driven software development life cycle. The objective is a practical development workflow in which models may propose requirements, designs, code, tests, or proofs, while deterministic checkers, versioned evidence, and human authority determine what is accepted.
**Responsibilities**
* Develop autoformalization methods that translate policies, procedures, regulations, requirements, and process descriptions into typed rules, process models, contracts, and formal specifications. * Design restricted domain-specific languages and formal semantics that domain experts and engineers can review together, with clause-level provenance and versioned change histories. * Build validation stacks using controlled source language, concretization, counterexamples, back-translation, cross-representation consistency, independent dual translation, and expert adjudication. * Create specification-mutation, non-vacuity, and seeded-defect benchmarks that measure detection rates for omissions, weakenings, exception errors, and mistranslations. * Integrate satisfiability modulo theories solvers, model checkers, theorem provers, static analyzers, type systems, and property-based or fuzz testing into independent verification harnesses. * Develop verifier-guided generation and repair methods for specifications, code, tests, invariants, proofs, and counterexamples while keeping the checker outside the generative model's trusted path. * Apply formal methods across the AI-driven software development life cycle, from requirements and architecture through model-generated implementation, continuous integration, release evidence, monitoring, and change-impact analysis. * Study composition at system scale, proof and specification maintenance under change, and methods for preserving evidence across tool, model, dependency, and compiler versions. * Connect formal artifacts to AIVista's data, rule, action, and process ontologies so runtime decisions can be traced to governing sources, versions, evaluated values, and accepted checks. * Define assurance claims with explicit scope, assumptions, trusted components, checker versions, and acceptance boundaries; prevent stronger claims than the evidence supports. * Partner with product and engineering teams to transition successful methods into production authoring, verification, and AI-driven software development workflows. * Lead publications, patents, open-source contributions, and research partnerships in formal methods, programming languages, software engineering, knowledge representation, and AI-driven software development.
NTT DATA AIVista | Formal Methods for AI Driven Software Development Life CyclePage
**Qualifications**
**Basic**
* PhD in computer science, programming languages, formal methods, software engineering, artificial intelligence, mathematics, or a related field, or equivalent industry impact. * At least 5 years of experience in formal methods, software engineering research, artificial intelligence, or machine learning, with significant experience applying research in production environments. * A proven record of impactful research demonstrated through publications, patents, open-source tools, formal artifacts, or shipped software products. * Deep experience in at least two relevant areas: formal specification, program verification, model checking, theorem proving, static analysis, type systems, program synthesis, requirements engineering, or autoformalization. * Hands-on experience building with at least one proof assistant, theorem prover, satisfiability solver, model checker, static analyzer, or verification-aware language. * Strong foundations in logic, algorithms, semantics, software architecture, and experimental design, with the ability to state exactly what a check proves and assumes. * Proficiency in Python and at least one additional production language, with experience building research prototypes and developer tools that engineering teams can maintain.
**Preferred**
* Experience with large-language-model autoformalization, neural theorem proving, verifier-guided generation, proof repair, or AI-driven program synthesis and code generation. * Experience with controlled natural language, specification mining, domain-specific languages, traceability, or translating requirements into executable artifacts. * Experience with ontologies, semantic modeling languages, description logics, graph constraint languages, rule engines, or policy-as-code systems. * Experience modeling business processes, distributed systems, protocols, authorization policies, or workflow semantics using temporal logic, state machines, Petri nets, or Business Process Model and Notation. * Experience with proof-carrying artifacts, verified compilation, deductive verification, symbolic execution, abstract interpretation, or assume-guarantee reasoning. * Experience with property-based testing, fuzzing, metamorphic testing, mutation testing, benchmark construction, or independent checker design. * Experience integrating formal evidence into continuous integration and delivery, change management, artifact versioning, provenance, and reproducible builds. * Experience applying formal or semantic methods in regulated or high-stakes domains and collaborating with legal, compliance, safety, or domain experts.
**Benefits**
* Medical, dental, and vision insurance * 401(k) plan * Significant company Health Savings Account contribution * Paid holidays and flexible paid time off
**Compensation**
The estimated base salary range for this role is $300,000 to $400,000 USD. The salary for the successful applicant will depend on job-related factors such as education, training, work experience, business needs, and market demands. This range may be modified in the future. Total compensation also includes variable pay in the form of an annual target bonus and other cash incentives, with a combined potential of up to 100% of base salary.
**Equal Opportunity Employment**

item.title: Lead Data Scientist, Cloud Distribution & Growth - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco and Seattle
**About the Team**
Cloud service providers give developers a way to use OpenAI models in the environments where they already build and run software. Our team works with Go-to-Market (GTM), Product, Engineering, and Finance to understand which customers we can reach through these providers and what helps them grow from a first API call to a production workload.
**About the Role**
In your first few months, you’ll identify a customer segment or workload where OpenAI can grow, recommend an investment to GTM, Product, and Engineering, and define how we’ll know whether it brought new usage to OpenAI. Your first priority will be to explain what drives usage and revenue across providers. You’ll use that understanding to help GTM decide which customers and workloads to invest in and to build forecasts the team can plan against.
A customer might sign a substantial cloud commitment and send very little traffic. You can sit down with the account team, trace the customer’s first requests, and work out whether they need help launching, access to a different model, or more capacity. When you see the same opportunity across customers, your work can change where OpenAI invests.
**In This Role, You Will:**
* Build a reliable view of the business from provider usage reports, billing records, and API logs. Show how new workloads, expansion, changes in price, and shifts in model mix contribute to growth. * Estimate how much demand cloud distribution adds to OpenAI. Trace customer activity across channels to distinguish new use cases from traffic that moved from the direct API. * Identify where customers are ready to scale. Combine what account teams hear with evidence on request failures, latency, and model availability. Work with Product and Engineering on a change and measure what happens to usage. * Shape growth plans with GTM and Finance. Estimate what existing workloads and upcoming launches can contribute by year end, test the assumptions that matter most, and recommend where to focus with each provider. * Own the consumption forecast. Compare forecasts with actual usage over the same period, explain the biggest misses, and use what you learn to improve the next forecast.
**You Might Thrive in This Role If You:**
* Like questions that take you from a conversation with an account team to a query about a single API request. You’re curious about why a customer’s behavior differs from what the numbers first suggest. * Are comfortable making a recommendation while some questions are still open. You can tell a sales leader where you’d invest and explain to an engineer what evidence would change your mind.
**Qualifications**
* Experience independently leading data science work on a product, growth, or commercial question that changed a business decision. * Strong SQL and Python skills. You can join incomplete datasets, choose the right unit of analysis, and validate an aggregate result against individual customers or workloads. * Experience using cohorts, experiments, or observational comparisons to assess what drove a change. You can explain how customer selection affects the conclusion and evaluate a forecast against a simple baseline.
**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with API platforms, cloud marketplaces, enterprise GTM, or a usage-based business. * Experience connecting service reliability or capacity to customer adoption, or using demand forecasts to guide a commercial or infrastructure investment.

AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core the full spectrum of humanity.

item.title: Data Scientist, Integrity - OpenAI
item.description:
Data Science - San Francisco
**About the Team** ==================
OpenAI’s Integrity team protects people and businesses using ChatGPT, Codex, and the API from fraud, abuse, and harmful misuse. Our work spans payment and promotional abuse, compromised accounts and API credentials, business and advertiser integrity, and emerging misuse of frontier AI capabilities. We also help product teams measure authentic usage so that abuse doesn’t distort decisions about how our products are growing.
Integrity Data Science helps teams decide where to intervene and whether those interventions work. A payment control can prevent fraud while blocking legitimate purchases. A product launch can make it easier for customers to get started while creating new opportunities for abuse. We measure both sides of those decisions.
**About the Role** ==================
As a Data Scientist on Integrity, you’ll find emerging abuse patterns, size their impact, and lead the analytical work behind decisions about detection, enforcement, and product launches. You’ll work with Product, Engineering, Research, Policy, and Operations to turn findings into improvements and measure what happens after they ship.
* Investigate anomalous activity across products. Estimate how common a problem is, who is affected, and what it costs users or the business. Use that evidence to recommend where to focus. * Define outcome metrics and guardrailsance. * Help build and evaluate detection rules, classifiers, and human review workflows. Use labeled samples and review outcomes to understand what the systems miss, where they flag legitimate activity, and how those errors vary across users and products. * Design randomized holdouts and use quasi-experimental or observational methods when randomization is impractical. Estimate harm or fraud losses prevented alongside effects on legitimate users, revenue, compute costs, and review workload. Recommend whether to launch, expand, adjust, or retire a control. * Trace where signals, review decisions, or enforcement actions break down. Work with partners to close gaps and build reusable datasets, analyses, and investigation tools.

You'll work with engineering, research, product, policy, and legal to design and build measurement and mitigation strategies, quantifying trade-offs between user friction and safety risks.
### **Data Scientist, Meta Superintelligence Labs (Safety) Responsibilities:**
* Measure abuse: build statistical telemetry and measurement frameworks to detect and monitor policy violations or emergent harms * Scale model evaluation: design a scalable framework adapting to evolving agentic model capabilities and safety/risk landscape, grounded in statistics * Evaluate and optimize safeguards: scale offline and online performance evaluation of our safeguards using human-in-the-loop and active learning * Design experiments and analyses: Conduct controlled experiments and rollouts to evaluate the impact of policy or risk definition changes and safety mitigations * Build intelligence and reporting: build signals, pipelines, dashboards to enable real-time monitoring driving interventions and safety roadmaps
### **Minimum Qualifications:**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent practical experience * 12+ years of experience in product data science, applied analytics, or quantitative research, including leading complex analytical workstreams in an individual contributor capacity * 12+ years of experience with data querying languages (e.g., SQL), scripting languages (e.g., Python or R), and statistical or mathematical software for large-scale data analysis * Experience developing and applying advanced statistical methods including predictive modeling, causal inference, experimentation design, and time series forecasting in a product context * Experience influencing product strategy and executive decision-making through data-driven narratives, written analytical frameworks, and stakeholder alignment across multiple cross-functional teams * Experience establishing analytical standards, data infrastructure best practices, or measurement frameworks adopted broadly across an organization or business domain
### **Preferred Qualifications:**
* Experience adhering to and implementing responsible, ethical AI practices (e.g., risk assessment, bias mitigation, quality and accuracy reviews) * Experience defining and scaling self-service analytics platforms or data explorability tools that reduce time-to-insight for non-technical stakeholders * Demonstrated use of AI tools to accelerate analytical workflows, including responsible validation of AI-generated outputs and adherence to ethical AI practices * Background in ambiguous and sparse data environments to operationalize e.g. harm prevalence measurement, causal inference, root-cause analysis– rooted in quantitative and statistical foundations * Demonstrated ability to integrate AI tools to optimize/redesign workflows and drive measurable impact (e.g., efficiency gains, quality improvements) * Experience working in fast-paced, high-ambiguity, cross-functional environments – able to jump from agentic trace deep-dives to explaining risk dimensions in plain English to policy stakeholders * Demonstrated ongoing AI skill development (e.g., prompt/context engineering, agent orchestration) and staying current with emerging AI technologies * Advanced degree (Master's or PhD) in a quantitative field such as Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Economics, or Operations Research * Experience in frontier AI products or risks, and navigating online, adversarial environments in Trust & Safety or Fraud/Risk/Security domains. Model evals, threat modelling, actor telemetry, human-in-the-loop review systems don’t sound foreign to you
### **About Meta:**
Meta builds technologies that help people connect, find communities, and grow businesses. When Facebook launched in 2004, it changed the way people connect. Apps like Messenger, Instagram and WhatsApp further empowered billions around the world. Now, Meta is moving beyond 2D screens toward immersive experiences like augmented and virtual reality to help build the next evolution in social technology. People who choose to build their careers by building with us at Meta help shape a future that will take us beyond what digital connection makes possible today—beyond the constraints of screens, the limits of distance, and even the rules of physics.
Meta is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, transgender status, sexual stereotypes, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Meta participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law. Please note that Meta may leverage artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies in connection with applications for employment.
Meta is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities in our recruiting process. If you need any assistance or accommodations due to a disability, please let us know at accommodations-ext@meta.com.

item.title: Staff Data Scientist - Turbotax Product - Intuit
item.description:
**Overview** ------------
As a Staff Data Scientist, you will lead the development of analytical frameworks and insights for new and fast-evolving product experiences. You will set the measurement and decision-making standard for initiatives where there is no established playbook.
You will partner with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, Expert Services, and Operations to assess emerging opportunities, shape experimentation strategy, and determine which capabilities should be refined, scaled, or deprioritized.
A growing part of this portfolio is agentic product experiences, both customer-facing (AI assistants and guided workflows that help customers complete their taxes or get answers) and expert-facing (tools that support experts in preparing returns, advising customers, and working more efficiently). You will define how these experiences are evaluated, including how to measure task success, quality, trust, customer and expert satisfaction, efficiency, and business impact. You will design experiments and observational approaches that work for non-deterministic, conversational systems, and help teams use evaluation signals (human review, automated judges, behavioral data) to improve agent performance over time.
Because many of these capabilities are newly established, you will help define how success is measured rather than applying existing performance frameworks. You will combine rigorous analysis with strong business judgment to bring clarity to ambiguous questions, create compelling performance narratives, and help leadership make confident investment decisions.
**Responsibilities**
### **Zero-to-One Measurement**
Develop measurement strategies for nascent products, programs, and business models where established benchmarks and metrics may not yet exist. Define leading indicators, learning milestones, success criteria, and pathways to scale.
### **Experimentation and Learning Agendas**
Shape analytical and experimentation roadmaps for emerging initiatives. Help teams move from broad hypotheses to measurable tests, interpret results in context, and determine the next best action.
### **Customer Lifecycle Intelligence**
Build a deeper understanding of how customers engage with TurboTax before, during, and after tax season. Identify opportunities to strengthen acquisition, early commitment, year-round engagement, retention, and long-term customer value.
### **Executive-Facing Visualization and Storytelling**
Develop compelling visualizations, dashboards, and presentations that enable leadership to quickly understand performance, tradeoffs, and emerging opportunities. Bring simplicity and clarity to complex or incomplete analytical narratives.
### **Scalable Performance Frameworks**
Create analytical frameworks that connect early customer signals to longer-term business outcomes. Establish consistent metrics, definitions, and decision criteria as new initiatives mature.
### **Cross-Functional Influence**
Serve as a trusted data science partner to senior leaders across Marketing, Product, Expert Services, and Operations. Facilitate alignment through data and create a shared understanding of hypotheses, performance drivers, risks, and opportunities.
### **Growth Portfolio Intelligence**
Develop integrated views of the emerging-growth portfolio to help leaders understand where momentum is building, where additional learning is required, and where resources may generate the greatest impact.
### **Data-Driven Operating Rhythm**
Support business reviews, investment decisions, and planning cycles with analytical views that reveal progress, key learnings, customer response, and the drivers of growth.
### **Thought Leadership and Enablement**
Champion best practices in experimentation, measurement, visualization, and decision science. Mentor other data scientists and analysts and contribute to a culture of rigorous, data-informed innovation.
**Qualifications**
* 5+ years of experience in data science, analytics, business intelligence, or a related field, ideally within consumer technology, financial technology, marketplaces, or SaaS environments. * Proven track record of shaping strategy and influencing executive decision making through data. * Experience supporting zero to one products, emerging business models, growth initiatives, or other highly ambiguous problem spaces. * Strong expertise in experimentation, performance measurement, customer analytics, and causal or decision-oriented analysis. * Demonstrated ability to define success metrics and learning frameworks for initiatives without established benchmarks. * Strong business acumen across customer acquisition, engagement, retention, product strategy, and operations. * Expertise in data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms. * Advanced SQL proficiency and experience using Python or R for analysis, modeling, and automation. * Exceptional storytelling and communication skills, with the ability to craft clear and compelling business narratives from complex or incomplete data. * Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and deliver impact in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. * Ability to balance analytical rigor with speed, judgment, and pragmatic decision-making.
Intuit provides a competitive compensation package with a strong pay for performance rewards approach. This position may be eligible for a cash bonus, equity rewards and benefits, in accordance with our applicable plans and programs (see more about our compensation and benefits at Intuit®: Careers | Benefits). Pay offered is based on factors such as job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and work location. To drive ongoing fair pay for employees, Intuit conducts regular comparisons across categories of ethnicity and gender.

San Diego $185,500 - $251,000

item.title: Sr. Applied Scientist, AWS Applied AI Solutions - Amazon.com
item.description:
**DESCRIPTION** ---------------
AWS Applied AI Solutions (AAIS) is building toward a future where every business innovates with Amazon AI teammates. To get there, we build AI solutions that improve human capabilities and transform entire business functions. We create end-to-end products that surprise and delight out-of-the-box, making complex things easy and hard things possible, with no cloud experience required. We start with customers who embrace the future and build bridges to meet the rest where they are. We pursue ambitious opportunities with conviction, and we are looking for builders who share that mindset.
Just Walk Out (JWO) is a new kind of store with no lines and no checkout-you just grab and go! Customers simply use the Amazon Go app to enter the store, take what they want from our selection of fresh, delicious meals and grocery essentials, and go!
Our checkout-free shopping experience is made possible by our Just Walk Out Technology, which automatically detects when products are taken from or returned to the shelves and keeps track of them in a virtual cart. When you're done shopping, you can just leave the store. Shortly after, we'll charge your account and send you a receipt. Check it out at amazon.com/go. Designed and custom-built by Amazonians, our Just Walk Out Technology uses a variety of technologies including computer vision, sensor fusion, and advanced machine learning. Innovation is part of our DNA! Our goal is to be Earth's most customer centric company, and we are just getting started. We need people who want to join an ambitious program that continues to push the state of the art in computer vision, machine learning, distributed systems, and hardware design.
Key job responsibilities
* Everyone on the team needs to be entrepreneurial, wear many hats, and work in a highly collaborative environment that's more startup than big company. We'll need to tackle problems that span a variety of domains: computer vision, image recognition, machine learning, real-time and distributed systems. * As a Sr. Applied Scientist you will help solve a variety of technical challenges and mentor other scientists. You will be the thought leader of the team. You will tackle challenging novel situations every day and given the size of this initiative you'll have the opportunity to work with multiple technical teams at Amazon in different locations. You should be comfortable with a degree of ambiguity that's higher than most projects and relish the idea of solving problems that frankly haven't been solved at scale before - anywhere. Along the way we guarantee that you'll learn a ton, have fun, and make a positive impact on millions of people. * Develop a novel framework and advance the theory and practice of multi-object tracking, re-identification, person activity understanding, multi-modal foundation model, and generic video understanding. Create innovative techniques for efficient visual processing that can scale to real-world applications. Investigate approaches to reduce the computational and data requirements of visual AI systems.
About the team Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn't followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don't let it stop you from applying.
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world's most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that's why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why flexible work hours and arrangements are part of our culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there's nothing we can't achieve in the cloud.
Here at AWS, it's in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
We're continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth's Best Employer. That's why you'll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS** ------------------------
* PhD, or Master's degree and 6+ years of applied research experience * Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS** ----------------------------
* Experience with modeling tools such as R, scikit-learn, Spark MLLib, MxNet, Tensorflow, numpy, scipy etc. * Experience with large scale distributed systems such as Hadoop, Spark etc.
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.
Los Angeles County applicants: Job duties for this position include: work safely and cooperatively with other employees, supervisors, and staff; adhere to standards of excellence despite stressful conditions; communicate effectively and respectfully with employees, supervisors, and staff to ensure exceptional customer service; and follow all federal, state, and local laws and Company policies. These include the duties and responsibilities listed above, as well as the abilities to adhere to company policies, exercise sound judgment, effectively manage stress and work safely and respectfully with others, exhibit trustworthiness and professionalism, and safeguard business operations and the Company’s reputation. item.title: Principal Data Scientist, Creator - Roblox
item.description:
San Mateo, CA, United StatesData Science & Analytics ID: 48080
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device.We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
**WHY DATA SCIENCE & ANALYTICS?**
The Data Science & Analytics organization's mission is to increase our speed, frequency, and acumen of making decisions at scale by instilling a data-influenced approach to building products. We cover a wide area of the data spectrum including analytical data engineering, product analytics, experimentation, causal inference, statistical modeling, and machine learning. Aligned and partnering with product verticals, we use this extensive toolbelt to discover new opportunities and unmet use cases, influence and shape the product roadmap and prioritization, build data products, and measure impact on our community of players and creators.
**WHY CREATOR?**
At Roblox, the Creator team is responsible for the systems that determine how creators generate and distribute games, license and share their IP, protect against clones, and thrive on the platform. As we move into a new era of AI tooling, game creation becomes much more accessible to a broad audience. We need to develop new tools and products to harness these new capabilities, and put new thought into protection against clones. As a Principal Data Scientist, you will be the primary strategic data partner across some of the most business-critical areas in the Creator space.
This is a high-ownership, high-autonomy role. You will work across economy, measurement, data infrastructure, and AI-enabled analytics — owning end-to-end problem framing, model development, and executive-facing recommendations in areas that directly shape platform integrity and creator success.
**You Will:**
* **Drive Build Analytics:** Develop and refine the suite of metrics used to track product success for Build — our new platform for generating games directly from user prompts. Define success metrics, guardrail metrics, and directly inform the product direction, from model spec decisions, to UI improvements, to pricing structure. * **Own Clone Detection:** Serve as the primary DS owner for clone detection modeling and consequencing — developing systems that distinguish between derivatives and full-on clones, and informing policies for how to intervene when clones are discovered. Innovate on which signals to use to identify clones in production. * **Own IP Licensing Measurement:** establish framework for tracking adoption and impact of IP licensing. Help define the strategy for broader IP sharing, through avatars and licensed assets. * **Drive Creator Data Foundations:** Serve as DRI for core creator data infrastructure — documenting all key creator tables, designing trustworthy data contracts, and building the semantic layers and analytical frameworks that enable reliable self-serve analysis across the team. * **Enable Agentic & AI-Powered Analytics:** Lead DS AI enablement for the creator org — building skills, evaluation frameworks, and scalable AI-enabled workflows that reduce analyst toil and elevate the team's analytical capacity. * **Create Zero-to-One Frameworks:** Define analytical standards and measurement approaches for new, ambiguous product areas — translating complex technical systems into interpretable, movable metrics for product and engineering leadership.
**You Have:**
* **Seniority & Breadth:** Principal DS experience, with a track record of owning complex, cross-functional data problems end-to-end — from problem framing and data infrastructure through modeling, experimentation, and executive communication. * **Communication & Influence:** Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to translate technical findings into clear product and business recommendations for senior executives. Experience interacting directly with VPs and Senior VPs. * **Comfort with Ambiguity:** Experience operating independently in zero-to-one environments — defining the problem, building the data, and owning the answer without a playbook. * **Technical Leadership:** Ideally, someone who can raise the bar for adjacent DS workstreams through mentorship, code review, and cross-functional partnership. * **ML & Generative AI Chops:** Proven ability to build, evaluate, and maintain ML models, especially for game generation and asset similarity modeling. Experience with ecosystem or marketplace settings is a strong plus. * **Experimentation & Causal Inference:** Strong statistical rigor, experimentation design, and causal inference skills — ideally applied in complex, mediated settings where simple A/B tests don't tell the full story. * **AI for Analytics:** Deep understanding of agentic and self-serve analytics use cases, including how to turn DS workflows into scalable, AI-enabled products. Familiarity with evaluation frameworks for AI outputs. * **Data Foundation Expertise:** Ability to contribute to the data foundation layer for AI — including table documentation, semantic layer design, data contracts, and trustworthy infrastructure for AI-enabled analysis. * **Technical Depth:** Expert-level SQL and Python, with enough engineering fluency to work effectively across data pipelines, model outputs, and production-facing systems. * **Academic Background:** BS, MSc, or PhD in Computer Science, Statistics, Applied Math, or a related quantitative field.
